sentences.text: FDA first posted the dopamine hydrochloride shortage on 2017-11-06 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage has been on FDA's list for 108 months as of 2026-10-21.
Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) is a registered manufacturer for this product and its plant was classified OAI on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04.
Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and Baxter Healthcare also appear on FDA's shortage list with Current status.
HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Check inventory at Corvale East (12.3 days on hand), Corvale General (11.7 days), and Corvale Lakeside (13.8 days) and evaluate the alternate manufacturer option.
